resources.string: Search for a city below: the city, then the prefecture or state, then the country, so the right one of the world\'s many same-named places comes up. Home shows the line under its clock once Clean Your TV names this app in header_weather.
The first reading appears in a few seconds.
City, prefecture or state, country — e.g. Takizawa, Iwate, Japan
No place by that name. Add the prefecture or state and the country, in the spelling the map uses.
No answer from Open-Meteo. Check the TV\'s network and try again.

Weather from Open-Meteo (no key, no account). Clean Your TV reads this line from the content provider this app publishes; the launcher itself never goes online. The line refreshes when you open this screen and when Home reads it after 20 minutes, and the request carries nothing but the coordinates.
